command_line:
set -eu
cat > extract.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
paths <- args[1:2]
labels <- args[3:4]
gene <- args[5]
out <- args[6]
collapse_field <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.null(x)) return("")
  x <- paste(as.character(x), collapse = "; ")
  gsub("[\t\r\n]+", " | ", x)
}
one <- function(path, label) {
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  if (!(gene %in% rownames(obj))) stop(paste("missing gene", gene, "in", label))
  tab <- as.data.frame(obj)
  row <- tab[gene, , drop = FALSE]
  descriptions <- ""
  if ("description" %in% names(S4Vectors::mcols(obj))) {
    descriptions <- paste(S4Vectors::mcols(obj)$description, collapse = " || ")
  }
  meta_lines <- capture.output(str(S4Vectors::metadata(obj), max.level = 3))
  data.frame(
    file = label,
    class = paste(class(obj), collapse = ";"),
    metadata_names = collapse_field(names(S4Vectors::metadata(obj))),
    metadata_str = collapse_field(meta_lines),
    mcols_descriptions = collapse_field(descriptions),
    rowname = gene,
    baseMean = row$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = row$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = row$lfcSE,
    stat = row$stat,
    pvalue = row$pvalue,
    padj = row$padj,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
res <- do.call(rbind, Map(one, paths, labels))
write.table(res, file = out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
